reviews.author: Ayushi R
reviews.text:
I started training with Shashank as a complete beginner and was honestly quite intimidated by the gym at first. He has been incredibly patient throughout the process, taking the time to explain exercises, correct my form, and make sure I’m comfortable before pushing me further.

In just a few weeks I can already see my strength improving, which has been really motivating. Exercises that felt impossible initially now feel much more manageable.

Shashank has strong knowledge of training and body mechanics, and every session feels structured and purposeful. I’d definitely recommend him to anyone who is new to strength training or looking for a knowledgeable and patient trainer.

reviews.author: sudhir muralidharan
reviews.text:
Firstly, I agree that the gym is not the cheapest in the vicinity and at the outset, doesn't appear to be a large facility either. However, what sets them apart and definitely makes them worth the cost is the fact that their Trainers care about what you do, even when you haven't opted in for personal training (ofcourse, they would like for you to take that too), the facility is pristine and clean and the availability of steam, sauna and an icebath don't hurt one bit. They even agree to change the music when you ask them and it's almost never overcrowded.

I opted for personal training with Afsal for two months. He spent hours outside of just our training, made it a point to understand my lifestyle and worked around it, built my plan and routine, was very aware of challenges I faced and helped me go from 125 Kilos to 110 in 3 months, without once making me feel burnt out.

Overall, it's a brilliant facility and worth the time and effort.

reviews.author: Amrita Ramesh
reviews.text: Aurum is a great gym with a solid vibe and all the right equipment. I started training here in October 2026 with Afsal, and it’s been an amazing experience. He took time to review & understand my performance, goals, and worked on my  strengths. He ensured that I make  constant progress by raising the bar through strength & functional training. I can genuinely see and feel the transformation. Thank you Afsal for pushing me above my limits & not letting me give up which has only helped get stronger & better.

reviews.author: Shirley Lyster
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Aurum for the past year, and I can honestly say it’s been such a transformative experience for me. This was the first time I ever properly committed to the gym, and I truly didn’t think I’d stick with it. But here I am , one year later , and I actually love showing up.

Vishnu has been a huge reason for that. He’s incredibly thorough, consistent, and really knows how to read you ,  understanding exactly when to push you and when to hold you back. On days I didn’t feel motivated, he made sure I still showed up, and over time those unmotivated days became fewer and fewer. That consistency has made all the difference.

He’s also extremely patient and takes the time to explain form, technique, and the reasoning behind workouts, which really built my confidence as a beginner. What gave me even more confidence was the visible change I could see in myself -  both physically and mentally. It’s genuinely helped me grow stronger not just in the gym, but in how I see myself.

Aurum as a gym sets a really high bar in every way!  From the quality of equipment to the cleanliness and overall environment. Everything feels intentional and well thought out. The standards they maintain truly stand out, and it reflects in the experience you have every single day. The community here is also amazing and makes coming in even more special.

Grateful for Vishnu and the entire Aurum team. Highly recommend! 💛

reviews.author: Sampath Kumar R
reviews.text:
Feedback on Auram Luxury Gym & Personal Training Experience

I am Sampath Kumar R, 41 years old, with over 20 years of gym training experience.

After joining Auram Fitness, Indiranagar, I can confidently say this is one of the best fitness facilities in a prime location. The overall environment, equipment quality, and atmosphere are excellent, and it truly delivers great value for the money.

⸻

Personal Trainer Experience

I completed my personal training with Trainer Zuhaib, and I must say he is highly professional, well-groomed, and extremely knowledgeable.

His training approach is structured, precise, and scientific—almost like a fitness doctor. Every session is purposeful, and his guidance ensures steady progress.

The investment in personal training is absolutely worth it. You don’t just spend money—you see real returns in terms of results, transformation, and expert guidance.

⸻

Diet Plan & Results

I would rate his diet planning 100/100.

The diet is:
•	Simple
•	Highly effective
•	Completely customized

This is not something you find in generic AI apps or with regular trainers. It is clearly designed with deep understanding and practical experience.

I personally lost 10 kg fat while maintaining muscle mass, which is extremely difficult to achieve. Losing only fat while preserving muscle requires precision—and his plan delivered 100% results.

Final Verdict

I am extremely satisfied with both the gym and the personal training experience.

If you are serious about transformation, structured training, and real results—this is definitely the right place.

reviews.author: Mrinal Menon
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience training with Akshay at Aurum. He is extremely knowledgeable and places a strong emphasis on proper form and technique, which made a huge difference in both my strength and overall confidence in the gym. What I appreciated most was his focus on flexibility, mobility, and injury prevention — not just lifting heavier weights.

Akshay takes the time to correct posture, explain movements clearly, and ensure every exercise is done safely and effectively. His sessions are structured, challenging, and tailored to individual goals. I always felt supported and motivated, but never pushed in a way that risked injury.

If you’re looking for a trainer who truly understands the importance of long-term fitness and sustainable progress, I highly recommend Akshay.

reviews.author: T N
reviews.text:
I had a one-year membership at this gym, and my experience was a mix of positives and frustrations.

On the plus side, the facility itself is excellent — easily one of the best-equipped gyms I’ve used. The environment is clean, well-maintained overall, and the people (both members and trainers) are friendly and professional. The general membership fee is also quite reasonable for what you get.

However, there are some important downsides. When equipment breaks down, it tends to take longer than expected to get repaired, which can be inconvenient. Another issue is the lack of transparency around private training fees. Pricing seems to depend on your initial session and isn’t standardized, which can leave you feeling locked into a rate without clarity.

The biggest disappointment for me was the management. I was told I could pause my membership, but when I tried to resume it, the pause wasn’t honored properly. As a result, I ended up losing 3–4 months of my membership time. Unfortunately, the gym manager was unhelpful and didn’t resolve the issue.

Overall, while the facilities and community are great, the management and policies need serious improvement. Due to this experience, I’ve decided not to return.

reviews.author: Jean Rachel
reviews.text:
Training with Afsal at Arum Luxury Gym delivers real, visible results. His sessions are highly structured, with strong emphasis on correct form, progressive overload, and goal-based programming, which makes a noticeable difference in strength and body composition.

He also takes a holistic approach — closely monitoring diet, sleep, stress, and recovery, and giving practical guidance even between sessions to ensure progress doesn’t stall. His supplement knowledge is spot on, recommending only what’s truly effective and suited to individual needs.

If you’re serious about measurable progress and long-term fitness, Afsal is a trainer who gets results.

reviews.author: Milen Binu
reviews.text:
I’m honestly very disappointed with this Cult gym (Indiranagar 6th Main). Today my helmet was either stolen or picked up by someone “by mistake” from inside the premises, and there is absolutely no accountability from the gym.
There is ZERO security. Literally anyone can walk in, take someone else’s belongings, and walk out without being questioned. For a place that charges premium fees, basic safety of members’ belongings is the bare minimum.
What’s worse is the response from the staff — CCTV footage apparently takes 24–48 hours to access. So until then, you’re just left hanging with no immediate help or action. No urgency, no responsibility.
This is not acceptable. If you can’t ensure safety inside your own facility, at least have a proper system in place to handle such situations immediately.
Members, be careful with your belongings here. Clearly, you’re on your own.

Meeting Anubhav as a trainer felt like a coincidence at first. I wasn’t very keen initially since he is a functional specialist, and I’ve never really been a big fan of that style of training. But over the last 3+ months, he has completely changed my perspective.

Anubhav is truly a Pandora’s box when it comes to fitness and transformation. Not only have I lost 3 kgs, but I also feel far more energetic and active overall. According to him, even my dopamine levels seem much better now — and honestly, I can feel the difference.

What makes him stand out is his ability to see potential in people even before they see it in themselves. He constantly pushes you beyond your limits, not out of pressure, but because he genuinely believes in transformation. His stubbornness, discipline, and relentless focus on helping clients achieve real change is what makes him special.

If you’re looking for someone who is deeply invested in your progress and genuinely committed to transforming both your body and mindset, Anubhav is that person.

reviews.text:
One of the worst Cult centres I’ve ever visited — and I’ve been to multiple Pro and Elite gyms.
The Indira Nagar branch is extremely poorly maintained. The floors are dirty, water cans are left lying around everywhere, and weights are scattered across the floor with no organisation.

There is absolutely no staff presence to maintain hygiene or basic order. Mats are never cleaned, and there’s no manager visible to supervise or correct anything.

I’ve even seen people powerlifting in regular workout zones instead of the designated area, dropping weights harshly and creating a completely unsafe environment — again, with no one from the staff intervening.

Overall, this centre is chaotic, unhygienic and unsafe. I will never visit Cult Indira Nagar again.
If you want a well-managed and professional experience, I highly recommend Cult Kagadasapura — one of the best centres by far.

That said, the highlight for me is my personal trainer Sumit. He is extremely professional, friendly, and genuinely knows his stuff. His guidance is clear, well-structured, and tailored to your goals. He’s very motivating, ensures correct form, and really helps you stay consistent and push your limits safely.

reviews.author: Shn L
reviews.text:
Sumit Sahu has been my personal trainer for about 2 months now and it's been a great experience!
I can notice positive changes and growth under his careful guidance. He is very mindful of any limitations or injuries, and makes sure you make the most out of every session. He is quick to correct posture, focused during your sets ,and maintains a calm composure throughout. I highly recommend Sumit to anyone looking for a personal trainer!

In regards to the gym, my personal timings are flexible enough to avoid going during the peak hours, but I have noticed that it gets quite crowded closer to the time. I'm not sure I'd be able to navigate the crowd by myself, without my trainer, so I hope something can be done about it.

reviews.author: feature sky
reviews.text:

It was a fantastic gym. It's the place where personal trainers from other gyms would come and train their bodies. All around dedicated people. Full range of machines are available.
The gym has several helpful trainers employed on the floor whom you can go and ask for guidance.
Shout out to my boy and coach Tejas. Personally I loved working with him. He is the best at what he does. He is literally the best powerlifter in his weight and age category in India right now. Super informative and disciplined coach. With our efforts I managed to decrease my bf% from 20 to 18 while increasing my strength in all exercises.
If I'm ever in Bangalore again, I'll come and visit you guys.✌️

reviews.author: Lena Varghese
reviews.text:
Really happy with Relentless Strength. It’s one of those gyms where you can train properly without having to compromise. Strongman, powerlifting, weightlifting, machines it’s all there, and the equipment is top quality. The competition standard barbells are a big plus if you care about how you lift and want consistency in your training.
There’s also a great turf area for conditioning, which makes it easy to add sled work or conditioning finishers into sessions. The restrooms and showers are always clean, and having steam facilities after a hard workout just makes the whole experience better.
Overall, it’s just a well set up gym that makes you want to keep showing up.

reviews.author: Priyanka Gulge
reviews.text:
Tejas, my trainer- absolutely soft spoken, but his workout sessions- not at all! Fantastic trainer!
I joined this place thinking it’s just another gym, but to be honest, it’s not your regular space. It’s got some fab equipment and is absolutely spacious and clean! And what makes it better are the people you meet here, especially the trainers. I am glad I was able to meet my trainer here, who pushes me to be better every single session. Thank you Tejas, for pushing me and making me better every single session one day at a time. I feel good, I feel alive, I feel motivated. Every Single Time!

reviews.author: harsha okaly
reviews.text: From the moment you walk in, it’s clear this gym is built for hard workouts. The space is spacious and well-equipped with heavy-duty strength training gear, perfect for powerlifting, strongman movements, calisthenics, conditioning and more. If you’re tired of crowded, cramped commercial gyms, this place feels like a breath of fresh air for serious lifters.

reviews.author: Biren
reviews.text:
We attended the WTC karnataka championships event here in 03rd May 2025 and this review is not about the gym or services related to body building etc rather about the WTC KA event management.

Neat washrooms. Quite a spacious gym , the reason why they preferred hosting the events within the gym itself with 50+ participants.

Overpriced registration for all events , 3 categories, whopping ₹3K registration which signifies why sports has turned into a profitable business venture for greedy business class just like our education and healthcare, quite obvious why we shouldn't expect olympic medals from a corrupt nation like India . All developed nations provide education, healthcare and sports training for nearly free .

They could have offered refreshments to athletes at least .

The prize distribution is meaningless as they have medals and certificates to all.

They used their gym equipment for the competition which means they book profit from the registration fees .

For me , It's not recommended to participate in their future events . Feels like the whole day wasted .

reviews.author: Bhanu Dhanasekaren
reviews.text:
20 Years of Excellence: The Best Scientific Training and Supportive Fitness Community at Figurine Fitness!
I first joined Figurine Fitness back in 2003, and two decades later, my loyalty hasn't wavered. It's rare to find a facility that combines longevity with cutting-edge quality, but this gym is truly a cornerstone of Bangalore for good reason. If you are looking for long-term gym membership value and results, this is the place.
The primary strength of this gym lies in its staff. The trainers here are absolutely brilliant. They are more than just motivators; they are expert certified trainers who practice genuinely scientific fitness training. They possess a deep, practical knowledge base that goes far beyond basic instruction, ensuring every member receives the highest standard of care. My personalized training programs have consistently evolved over the years, guaranteeing maximum results safely and effectively. For anyone prioritizing knowledge and long-term health, these knowledgeable coaches set the standard for a top-rated fitness center.

The group fitness classes are the heartbeat of Figurine Fitness. The action-packed aerobics sessions are always fun and full of energy—a fantastic way to make exercise feel less like a chore and more like a great start to the day.
More importantly, the culture here fosters a truly supportive fitness community. The friends I've made over the last 20 years have become like family. This incredible, welcoming environment is what makes coming to the gym such a positive experience, solidifying its reputation as the best gym in Bangalore for community and motivation.
If you value scientific training, incredible community, and exceptional value, look no further. This is where you achieve your fitness goals.

reviews.author: Anuja aavishkar
reviews.text:
I have been attending  Figurine Fitness Zumba classes for the past few months. The classes are absolutely amazing! The energy is contagious, the music is fun and motivating, and easy to follow . Every class feels like a dance party where you’re burning calories without even realizing it.

The instructors are encouraging, positive, and makes everyone feel welcome—no matter your fitness level. I always leave class feeling sweaty, happy, and confident. If you’re looking for a fun way to get fit, boost your mood, and enjoy exercising, Figurine Fitness is the place to be.

reviews.author: Adithya Nayak
reviews.text: Indiranagar is home to a ton of gyms, the cult kind, the fancy kind, offbeat ones, but something about The Lazy Town immediately stands out in comparison to all these gyms. Housed in a cozy area, the gym has only one priority, fitness. It’s not run like a business but more like a center for you to find out your true capabilities and push yourself to get to your fitness goals. The people here are very sweet, almost like a community and the coach is a godsend. He will help you out in the initial days and give a plan based on your needs. He also makes sure you are consistent and will keep checking up on you and never allow you to get into your comfort zone. It has adequate amount of equipments and is a great place to workout. Been going here for nearly 2.5 months now and I have seen really good progress. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kumar Sourav
reviews.text:
one thing that stands out immediately is how neat and clean the space is — it’s genuinely well maintained, which makes a big difference in your daily workouts.

What I really appreciate is the overall atmosphere. It never feels overcrowded, and the training experience feels more focused and personal rather than chaotic. Speaking about Kundan — his knowledge is on another level. He’s the kind of person who is deeply passionate and almost “nerdy” about fitness in the best way possible. He understands the science behind workouts, tailors programs intelligently, and ensures you’re progressing the right way.

If you’re looking for a place that’s clean, well-structured, and offers a more personalized fitness journey, this gym is definitely worth it.

reviews.author: Elahe Tolideh
reviews.text:
As a non resident Indian new to Bangalore, I wanted a gym where I’d feel safe, comfortable, and still get a serious workout.

Woohoo Fitness really surprised me.
The space is modern and bright.
The equipment is international standard.

Trainers are professional, speak fluent English, and make you feel welcome.
The crowd is respectful, and the vibe is motivating without being intimidating.

Lockers and showers are clean, which matters a lot to me.
It’s one of the few gyms in India that feels truly global.

reviews.author: Aiman Shifa
reviews.text:
I absolutely love going to Woohoo Health Club. From day one, it has felt like more than just a gym, it’s truly an experience and a community.

The hygiene standards here are exceptional. The equipment is sanitized after every use, which makes working out feel safe and comfortable. The ambience is beautiful and energetic, yet calming at the same time. When I first joined, I didn’t know anyone and now it genuinely feels like a community. Everyone is so warm, welcoming, and sweet.

The personal trainers are absolutely splendid. I trained with Gayathri, and she was incredible  knowledgeable, respectful, and very mindful of my BCA, tailoring everything according to my needs. She pushed me while still ensuring I felt supported. The general trainers are equally amazing always present, approachable, and ready to help whenever needed.

Chaitra from Pilates, she is exceptionally good at what she does. The Pilates space itself is aesthetically designed and thoughtfully created, which makes every session even more enjoyable.

And the recovery facilities are splendid. Be it sauna, infrared therapy, steam, and ice bath just helps you recover faster and feels so nice at the end of the day. It’s that extra element that truly elevates the entire fitness journey.

Lastly, the owners deserve appreciation for building something so special. They are kind, helpful, and have done an outstanding job creating this space.

Woohoo is not just a gym, it’s an experience, a community, and a place that makes you genuinely look forward to working out every single day.

reviews.author: Kashish Grover
reviews.text:
All my partner and I wanted was a clean gym that we like going to. We are so glad to have found Woohoo gym. The floor trainers are amazing, and we felt welcome from day one. Unlike Cult, where gym trainers are never present, physically or mentally, this is a place where the floor trainers will observe you and prevent you from exercising the wrong way. We decided to take personal training to get a hang of it, and Chaitra has been an amazing trainer who pushes us and really makes us exercise the correct way. We will continue personal training for another month or two because we want to get the most out of our year long membership here and we want to remember how to exercise the right way.
Beyond that, they do have some nice recovery facilities, clean washrooms, and the gym smells good.

reviews.author: Gaurav Chaturvedi
reviews.text:
As someone who was completely new to the gym,  hiring a personal trainer has been one of the best decisions I've made for my fitness journey.

The facility itself is clean, well-maintained, and equipped with premium machines that make training enjoyable and approachable even for beginners. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the staff are always friendly and supportive.

A special mention to my trainer, Bilal. Starting out, I had very little knowledge about strength training and proper exercise technique. Bilal took the time to teach me correct form, explain the purpose behind each exercise, and build my confidence in the gym. His focus on movement quality and progressive strength development helped me avoid common beginner mistakes and steadily get stronger over time.

What I appreciate most is that he doesn't just tell you what to do—he helps you understand why you're doing it, which has made me much more consistent and motivated. I've seen noticeable improvements in both my strength and overall fitness since training with him.

reviews.author: Deudutta Nagori
reviews.text:

When I think of WooHoo I think of equipment and cleanliness levels like that of The Bay Club in San Francisco where I worked out previously.

Amazing job guys with the gym. Now just maintain it and you have a long term client.

Mr. Syed keeps bragging about the gym’s standards and equipment quality, but the reality is nothing like what he promises. Most of the equipment is almost always out of order, and the cardio machines look like they haven’t seen proper maintenance in at least two years. Instead of fixing anything professionally, they just tamper with the machines and offer temporary, unsafe fixes.

What hurts even more is that if you take a membership and later try to raise concerns about the poor quality, he rudely tells you to go to some other Cult gym. There’s no respect, no sincerity—just a desperate attempt to sell memberships. It’s really sad to see a gym fall to this level.

Zoom Fitness — A Strong Choice for Fitness Enthusiasts

I recently visited Zoom Fitness (Whitefield area) and was pleasantly impressed. Here’s a summary of my experience, paired with what other users have shared:

👍 What Works Really Well
1.	Clean, well-maintained facility
One thing you’ll notice right away is how tidy everything is. From the workout floors to the locker rooms, the gym is spotless and well looked after. Many users compliment the hygiene standards and upkeep.

There’s a solid variety of machines and free weights, which makes it easy to switch routines.
4.	Positive environment & accessibility
The overall atmosphere is encouraging — not intimidating — which makes it comfortable even for newcomers. The gym is also easy to reach, with good connectivity.

⸻

💡 A Few Tips / Things to Check
•	Peak hours: Like many good gyms, there might be crowding during early mornings or after-work hours. Try going during non-peak times for a more relaxed session.
•	Trainer matching: If you sign up for a personal trainer, check how well you gel with them (style, communication).
⸻

✅ Final Word

If you’re looking for a gym in Whitefield (or nearby) that combines cleanliness, good equipment, supportive staff, and decent pricing, Zoom Fitness is a strong option. reviews.author: Pinki Singh
reviews.text:
Will not recommend this gym to anyone.

In fact, I had recommended it to someone earlier and now I genuinely regret that.

I joined because I liked the space and the location, but the overall experience has been very disappointing from the intial few months of me joining. The staff, especially John and Renu, come across as highly unprofessional and seem more focused on upselling PT and meal charts than actually caring for the members already enrolled.

There is barely any attention given to whether people are doing exercises correctly or not, which is the most basic expectation from a gym.

What’s more disappointing is that there seems to be no effort to accommodate or retain existing clients. The focus is more on getting *more money* out of members than on providing a good experience.

Good infrastructure alone is not enough if the service and attitude are this poor.

reviews.author: Anand Vecham
reviews.text:
Joining The Outfit Gym has honestly been life-changing for me. Through their program, I managed to lose about 13 kilos and, more importantly, started feeling far healthier and stronger.

A huge shout-out to Kris, the founder, and the incredible team — Bharathesh, Abhi and Tej. Their professionalism, knowledge, and genuine commitment to helping people improve is exceptional. One thing that truly stands out about this gym is the importance they place on technique and proper form, ensuring that every movement is done right and safely.

What surprised me the most is that even in group classes, they still manage to give individual attention to everyone, which makes a massive difference.

The gym also offers great flexibility with multiple batches starting from 6:30 a.m. all the way till 7:30 p.m., and you can either join a structured class or work out on your own.

Beyond just workouts, they also guided me on what to eat, what to avoid, and how to build a sustainable lifestyle, which has been invaluable.

Today, this place genuinely feels like my second home. I’m extremely grateful to the entire team and everything they’ve done for me.

Kudos to the whole team at The Outfit Gym — I highly recommend it to anyone serious about getting healthier and stronger. 💪

reviews.author: Shruthi Aakkullu
reviews.text:
I joined this gym when I was at my physical worst, and today I’m fitter, stronger, and feel so much better about myself. A huge part of that journey is thanks to the incredible trainers here.

Tej, Bharatesh, and Abee are patient, knowledgeable, and truly committed to making sure we push ourselves to be our best. They pay close attention to posture, form, recovery, and diet, and always make sure workouts are both effective and fun.

What really sets this place apart is the sense of community they build. From organizing off-gym activities like sound meditation, ice baths for recovery, and sports like badminton and pickleball, they create opportunities for us to bond both inside and outside the gym.

A special thanks to Kris for constantly motivating us and making sure we don’t give up or fall into lazy habits.

It’s truly been a pleasure working out with all of you!

reviews.author: Narayan R
reviews.text:
I was of the opinion that cardio trumped all exercise until there was muscle loss that needed a physio. Thanks to Dr. Gladson's recommendation, I met with the OutfitX team.

Chris has created a great team that understands holistic fitness and ensures that no shortcuts are promised. Yes, fitness is organic, and there are no shortcuts.

My first session was with Coach Tej. Little did I know she was THE coach. Her depth of knowledge in human anatomy, exercises, form, and fitness, and her keen eye for bad form from a kilometer away, makes her “The Coach.” Now that the team has got me hooked on Olympic weightlifting, it’s going to be a great new learning experience.

Abee's enthusiasm and ability to push, Rohit's precision on timing, and Hrithik's ability to live by example make it a wholesome team. Yup, and one can’t forget Hemanth (:) or the welcoming Abhijeet (Bhaiya).

More power to the OutfitX team, and I wholeheartedly recommend them.

reviews.text:
For someone who has never been a gym person, Outfit completely changed my perspective. It’s not a typical gym with rows of equipment; instead, it’s a strength and conditioning facility. The environment is inclusive and welcoming to everyone.

The programs are engaging and thoughtfully planned, ensuring balanced attention to all muscle groups. The workouts are far from boring, and the variety keeps things interesting. The coaches are incredible—highly knowledgeable, encouraging, and attentive to each individual’s needs.

I highly recommend Outfit to anyone looking to start their fitness journey or even to those seeking a refreshing and supportive approach to working out.

reviews.author: N Chandrasekhar Ramanujan
reviews.text:
I've been a personal training client at this gym for over a year, across three package renewals totalling over ₹1,00,000. My experience has been deeply disappointing.

My trainer was absent for approximately 50 sessions over 12 months — roughly once a week. Each time, I was told to "just do cardio" on my own despite paying ₹500-700 per session for personal training. On multiple occasions he informed me he wouldn't be coming on the morning of the session or the night before — too late for me to cancel within the 8-hour cancellation window. I was then incorrectly marked as a no-show and charged ₹700 per session for days I physically attended the gym.

The personal training check-in system requires the trainer to scan a code to verify the session. My trainer routinely asked me to send this code over WhatsApp so he could mark sessions as completed remotely — on days he wasn't at the gym at all. He was billing for sessions he did not attend or deliver.

He told me he needed my renewal to meet his monthly target, and that he wouldn't get his Christmas leave approved without it. I renewed for ₹45k+. He left for vacation the next day. On a separate occasion, he pressured me to renew while I was recovering from surgery, again to meet his target.

After repeated no shows, when I raised these issues with the centre manager, nothing happened. I then spoke with Prajwal from support, who assured me the no shows would be resolved and asked me to continue attending. My trainer no-showed again for the next session.

I escalated via email to senior management. I was promised a callback from the backend team — it's been over 48 hours with no call. My trainer assignment is wrong, my sessions are expiring without being carried over as promised, and none of the agreed actions have been executed.

The gym facilities are fine. But the personal training service has serious structural problems — no substitute trainer when yours doesn't show up, no accountability for trainer attendance, a check-in system that can be gamed over WhatsApp, a no-show penalty that only punishes the client, and a support process that makes promises it doesn't keep.

I documented every session, every absence, and every conversation over 12 months. If you're considering personal training here, know that you may end up paying premium rates for unsupervised cardio with no recourse when things go wrong.

reviews.author: Abhirami VS
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at LiftR. The group sessions are incredibly well-structured, and the most important thing was how attentive the coaches are to every individual.

A big shoutout to Suraj, Arjun, and Vijay. They constantly ensure your posture and form are correct, which makes a huge difference in both safety and results. Their encouragement really pushes you to become a better version of yourself.

The 6-week program I attended was very insightful, especially in helping me understand the importance of diet alongside workouts. Special mention to Suraj for doing a fantastic job as the accountability manager — his guidance and support kept me consistent throughout the program.

I highly recommend LiftR to anyone who is looking to build healthier habits and bring positive change to their fitness journey.

reviews.author: Niveditha Kannan
reviews.text:
I did the 6-week transformation program at LIFTR HSR in December and it was honestly one of the best decisions I made for my fitness this year.

What stood out to me most was how structured and well thought out the program is. Every session had a clear focus on strength and conditioning, and the coaches were extremely attentive about form and technique, which made me feel safe pushing myself harder than I normally would.

The coaches are very encouraging but also hold you accountable, which makes a huge difference when you’re trying to stay consistent. The group environment also helps a lot — everyone is working towards their own goals but the energy in the room keeps you motivated.

Over the 6 weeks I felt noticeably stronger, fitter and more confident in my workouts. It also helped me build much better fitness habits that I’ve continued even after the challenge ended.

If you’re looking for a gym that goes beyond just giving you equipment and actually guides you through a structured fitness journey, I would highly recommend LIFTR.

reviews.author: Varshith Rk
reviews.text:
I would definitely recommend Liftr Strength & Conditioning Gym. They have well-planned sessions every day, which are highly motivating and very unique—especially the group workouts, which are absolutely amazing.

The coaches are extremely friendly and take time to explain every exercise in detail. They clearly tell us what we are doing and why we are doing it, which makes a huge difference. The instructions are detailed, professional, and easy to understand. On top of that, the entire place has a great vibe that keeps you motivated.

I travel from Sarjapur to HSR, which takes around 20–30 minutes, and I genuinely feel it’s worth it. Even on days when you’ve cheated on your diet, the very next day you feel super active and excited to attend the session. That’s how motivating and inspiring the environment is—it sets the tone for the entire day.

With the help of the coaches, I was able to reduce my weight from 78.9 kg to 72 kg, almost 6 kg. I feel really good seeing the transformation, and more importantly, I now have a solid understanding of nutrition, what I eat, and how to get back on track even after cheat days. Even after completing the 6-week challenge, I feel motivated to enroll in more such programs.

My online personal training coach for 4 weeks was Sreenath. He tracked my nutrition daily and helped me understand what was right and what wasn’t. He guided me in structuring my diet and workouts according to my goals and made sure I clearly understood every step of the process.

My daily session coaches were Suraj and Vijay. Both are extremely knowledgeable and very patient in explaining techniques in detail. They made sure we understood every movement properly and always took the time to correct and guide us during the sessions.

A few sessions were also taken by Afthab,
Arjun also conducted a few group sessions. He is very professional, and would get motivated by.

The last few sessions were taken by celebrity coach Michael Ajay. He has an incredible presence and energy in the gym. I would genuinely be happy to work with him again to plan and achieve my upcoming fitness goals.

Swati - Helped me to achieve and plan my overall goal setting and motivated me more. your the best!!

I truly enjoyed being part of this gym and would highly recommend Liftr to anyone planning to join.
Liftr team—you all are awesome! 💪🔥

reviews.author: Tavleen Kaur
reviews.text:
I’m extremely grateful to LIFTR  and all the amazing coaches here. I joined here for a 6 week challenge in Jan. When  first started, I never imagined how much my perspective on fitness would change.
The coaches created an environment that is supportive, motivating, and very focused on doing things the right way. They constantly helped me with the correct form for every exercise and made sure I stayed accountable to my goals. From workouts to diet plans, I got help in every way that helped me achieve my goals.
Because of them, I’ve gained so much confidence in myself. Lifting weights now feels empowering, and I genuinely look forward to my workouts. Losing almost 4 kgs and 10 inches didn’t seem like something I would actually achieve in 6 weeks but the constant support and guidance made the hustle fun. Thank you to the entire team for helping me fall in love with fitness and making this journey so enjoyable. Full Power💪🏻💪🏻

reviews.text: I joined Liftr’s 6-week challenge, and the experience has been nothing short of amazing. From the word go I felt EXTREMELY at ease with my now "lost touch with fitness" body because the environment here made me believe in myself and the training I was going to get here. No judgement, no unnecessary forces selling me memberships and no mediocre setup. Pure passion for fitness and compassion towards others and their very very human bodies. My first few months with group classes just proved these above points and my group sessions with Sam ended up pushing me harder to a better self with the help of Sam as my personal coach.

The road is long but the journey so far with Sam has been no short of AMAZING! He is probably the 5th personal trainer in my life and the only one so far who stopped my racing mind and made me believe and celebrate my smaller victories that are leading me to my better physical and mental strength.

I can not recommend this place and the community enough! I truly feel I found my space, my dojo and I am 110% sure this will give you the same feeling if you are thinking about it.

The group class formats are really really beneficial without being over crowded and chaotic.

Hyfit has truly been a positive influence in my fitness journey and I’d recommend it to anyone who is looking to start or continue their own.

The group class timings are convenient, with plenty of options to choose from, making it easy to stay consistent.

I recently had an injury, and the way the team handled it at the time of impact was very professional and reassuring. Even now, during classes, the coaches are attentive and make sure to modify workouts based on my injury. That level of care and attention really stands out.

Highly recommend Hyfit to anyone looking for structured training in a motivating and supportive environment!

reviews.author: pxp
reviews.text:
Rating: ⭐ (Zero Stars)

I rarely write reviews, but I had to warn everyone about this absolute disaster of a gym. This place is a complete scam and does not deserve the "Elite" tag at all. Save your hard-earned money and your health by staying far away. Here is the detailed reality check:

1. HORRIBLE MAINTENANCE & FILTHY ENVIRONMENT
The cleanliness here is non-existent. I have personally complained about the lack of cleaning more times than I can count. The floors are always sticky with sweat and dirt, the equipment has layers of dust and grime, and it smells bad. For a gym that claims to be premium, they can't even bother to wipe things down daily. It's unhygienic and honestly disgusting to work out in such a dirty place.

2. ACs ARE DEAD - IT'S LIKE A SAUNA INSIDE
It's peak summer right now, and working out here is absolute torture. The ACs barely work or are completely broken. I have raised this issue at least 20 times in the last 2 months. Every time they say "we'll fix it," but nothing changes. Within 10 minutes of stepping in, you're drenched in sweat and struggling to breathe. It's exhausting, draining, and takes away all the joy of working out. You feel dizzy and sick instead of feeling energized.

3. OVERCROWDED & SUFFOCATING AFTER 6 PM
If you have a job and can only work out after 6 PM, forget it. The gym turns into a crowded fish market. There are way too many members packed into a small space. You have to wait forever for every single machine. Combine this insane crowd with the broken ACs and poor ventilation, and it becomes a suffocating nightmare. It's impossible to focus on your workout when you can't even move or breathe properly. It's so demotivating that I often leave feeling frustrated rather than accomplished.

4. COMPLETELY USELESS MANAGEMENT
The management here is the laziest and most uncaring I have ever dealt with. They are experts at giving false assurances and nodding their heads, but they take zero action. When you go to them with genuine concerns about cleaning, broken ACs, or machine repairs, they just give you a blank stare and do absolutely nothing. It feels like they have no intention of solving any problems. They just want your money and don't care about your experience.

5. BROKEN MACHINES TAKE MONTHS TO FIX
This is the most frustrating part. If a machine breaks in any normal gym, it gets fixed within a day or two. Here? The Leg Curl/Leg Extension machine has been "under maintenance" for over a month now! It's the only machine of its kind, so if you need to train your hamstrings or quads properly, tough luck. There's no alternative, no temporary fix, nothing. It just sits there broken while they keep collecting full monthly fees from everyone.

FINAL WARNING TO EVERYONE:
Please, I beg you, do not fall for the brand name and join this gym. You will regret every single day. It is overpriced, poorly maintained, and the management is a joke.

To current members: If you are already trapped here, break your bond and shift to another gym as soon as possible. Any local gym in Marathahalli will treat you better than this place. Do not suffer like I am.

Stay away! This gym is a complete headache!

reviews.text:
I’ve had an excellent experience at Lynx Fitness - Best Gym In Marathahalli. The gym is equipped with modern machines and equipment, the hygiene and cleanliness are very well maintained, and the staff and trainers are extremely friendly, approachable, and supportive.

A special mention to Charan, who has been an exceptional trainer throughout my fitness journey. I joined the gym while recovering from a rotator cuff injury in my right shoulder and a wrist injury in my left hand. I was honestly quite hesitant to get back into strength training because I was worried about making the injuries worse. That’s when I decided to train under someone experienced in injury recovery and functional fitness - and I’m really glad I found Charan.

What impressed me the most was our very first interaction during the body composition analysis and fitness assessment. His approach towards fitness was completely different from the typical “just build muscles” mindset. He spoke about the importance of mobility, flexibility, endurance, posture, recovery, and overall functional fitness along with strength training. As someone with an athletic background, that instantly gave me confidence that I was training with the right person.

Over the past few months, not only has my strength improved significantly, but I’ve also regained proper mobility and range of motion in both my shoulder and wrist. He pays close attention to posture, technique, warm-ups, activation exercises, stretching, and recovery to ensure workouts are effective and safe. His guidance on training discipline, injury prevention, and recovery has genuinely made a huge difference for me.

Charan is highly professional, knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely passionate about helping people improve their fitness the right way. If you’re looking for a trainer who focuses not just on aesthetics but on long-term fitness, mobility, and overall well-being, I would highly recommend training with him.

Highly recommend the gym as well for the overall environment and quality of facilities.

reviews.author: Sandeep Kumar
reviews.text:
1/5 stars - Disappointing Experience 🚫

I recently visited the Cult.fit center, and my experience was quite disappointing. The gym is spacious and has good ventilation, but that's where the positives end. The gym was heavily crowded, making it difficult to work out effectively.

Equipment Issues:

- Most machines were not working, which was a major letdown.
- The two squat racks were subpar. One didn't have a mirror to check bar position, and the other had an uneven floor.
- The seated cable row machine has been out of order for over a month.
- The two cable crossover machines were incomplete, lacking hooks to adjust the cable.

Treadmill Issues:

- The treadmills were frequently under maintenance, making it impossible to use them.

Final Verdict:

Given the numerous equipment issues and overcrowding, I would strongly advise against taking a membership at this gym. Until they address these problems, I wouldn't recommend wasting your money.

Rating Breakdown:

- Cleanliness: 3/5
- Equipment: 1/5
- Crowd: 1/5
- Overall Experience: 1/5

Advice: Look elsewhere for a better gym experience.

I am extremely disappointed with the behavior and attitude of the current Marathahalli franchise manager. My experience during the interaction was highly unprofessional and quite rude. Basic customer interactions should be handled with courtesy, respect, and professionalism, and unfortunately those standards were missing in this case. This review and rating are specifically directed toward the manager and are not a reflection of the fitness services offered by the center.

On the positive side, despite this experience, the personal training services have been excellent. The trainers are highly professional, experienced, supportive, and genuinely dedicated to helping members achieve their goals. I have personally seen significant improvements in my fitness journey after joining Iconic Fitness. I would definitely recommend the trainers and training programs here. I only hope the customer management experience improves so that it reflects the same level of quality and professionalism demonstrated by the training staff.

reviews.author: Sujan Sujju
reviews.text:
One of the worst gyms I have ever seen.

Even after paying a huge amount of money, the management is extremely disappointing. They do not care about the facilities or infrastructure at all. The most shocking part is that there has been no power for almost a week, and there is absolutely no power backup. All the treadmills are not working, and trainers are forced to conduct sessions using emergency lamps. This is completely unacceptable for a gym that charges premium fees.

There is also no proper ventilation inside the gym. It feels suffocating while working out, which makes it very uncomfortable and unhealthy. Despite multiple complaints from members, the management has taken no action and seems least bothered about improving the situation.

The only positive aspect is that the trainers are good and supportive. However, good trainers alone cannot make up for such poor facilities and infrastructure.

If you are truly dedicated to fitness and looking for a professional environment, I strongly recommend that you do not choose this gym.

reviews.author: Ajay Prakash
reviews.text:
❌ WARNING: Save your money and avoid Iconic Fitness Marathahalli!
Even after reading this review if someone wants to join this gym, who consider this gym for walkable distance or anything specific, please don’t take 1yr/ 3mon/ 6mon plan. Just go for 1 month plan and decide later based on your experience.

I am 5 months into a 15-month membership and it’s the worst financial decision I’ve made. The gym is highly unhygienic, the steam room is never cleaned (includes- toilet, dress changing room), and the showers and taps don't work, and they have hand dryer without connection, mirror is unfixed, especially the whole room smells bad. Even basic drinking water is constantly dry, forcing members to repeatedly complain just to get a drink.  No basic parking facilities.

To make matters worse, there is a severe shortage of essential equipment like dumbbells and benches, meaning you waste half your time waiting. Complaining is entirely useless because both the managers and the trainers keep changing every few weeks. EVEN THE CURRENT MANAGER IS NOT ACCOUNTABLE. The current manager promised refund if these issues are not solved, but nothing happened. Im tired of addressing the issue. I NEED REFUND.

This place is a complete waste of money. If you are thinking of joining, DO NOT. Gym management, please change your terrible operations before you completely shut down. This gym is Strongly not recommend!

❗️To the gym owner, if you are reading this review: I’m sorry to say, but you are better off closing this gym entirely. I have been in the fitness industry for 6+ years across different cities, and this is the worst gym I have ever experienced. ❗️

There are far better alternatives available.

reviews.author: Nazeem Hassan
reviews.text:
I had a disappointing experience at RXDX, which claims to be a premium center but operates far from it. There is a clear lack of structure and coordination among staff. My checkup, which could have been completed in one visit, required two trips.

On the first day, I underwent blood, urine, ECG, and X-ray tests. Despite informing them that scanning and a treadmill test were pending, they only realized this when i informed them by which time the doctor had left. At 10am doctor left the centre and they call themselves as premium centre without doctor.

When I came back the following week, the center was understaffed. I had to personally inform a nurse about my pending tests, and even then, I had to wait a long time for the treadmill test as the staff and doctor arrived late. Patients are asked to come at 7:30 AM for samples, only to face hours of waiting.

Another concerning issue is the lack of basic hygiene practices. After the ECG and scanning, the lubricant used was not wiped off by the staff, and I was directed to do it myself with tissues. For a center charging premium prices, this is unacceptable.

The current staffs are doing great job but managing lot of patience with three staffs is impossible, RXDX needs to improve its scheduling, staffing, and overall patient care to justify its premium tag. Until then, it feels like a standard center charging premium rates.

They have a wide, high-quality range of equipment for every major muscle group. The variety is impressive—for chest alone, they have a standard bench, a standing press machine, and two Smith machines, which is rare to find. Leg days are equally well-supported with a hack squat, pendulum squat, and leg press. Because of this variety, you never have to wait around; there's always an alternative available even if a machine is occupied.

The training and support here are also Very Very Good They offer personal training and diet advice, but even the general guidance is fantastic. Unlike many big-brand gyms, the trainers here actually care about the general members and pay close attention to ensure your form and technique are correct.

reviews.author: Nagaranjani J
reviews.text:
DO NOT JOIN THIS GYM.

This place has seriously gone downhill. It used to be good, but now it’s poorly managed and unsafe. Here are the key issues:
1.	No control over weight re-racking
Weights are constantly left all over the floor. This is not just inconvenient — it’s dangerous. I’ve seen people almost trip over heavy plates multiple times. Even basic machines are unusable because weights are not cleared.
This is not a member problem alone — it clearly shows zero supervision from trainers and management.
2.	Complete lack of safety during maintenance
Today, staff started cleaning ceiling vents during peak hours without any warning. Dust fell all over the gym floor while people were working out. Many members, including myself, experienced discomfort and allergy issues.
This is a serious health risk and reflects no planning or concern for members.
3.	Unresponsive management & no equipment upgrades
Several members have repeatedly requested additional equipment, but nothing has been done. It feels like feedback is completely ignored.
4.	Absent ownership & poor accountability
The franchise owner being remote is clearly reflected in how the gym is run — there is no accountability or ownership on the ground.
5.	Unprofessional staff behavior
Trainers and center managers are often seen sitting around, watching reels, or chatting — instead of doing their job.
Re-racking enforcement, floor discipline, and member safety are basic responsibilities, yet completely neglected.
Ironically, the same staff becomes extremely active when it comes to membership renewals.

If this continues, this gym will deteriorate further. Right now, it does not justify the money members are paying

I would suggest you DON’T join this gym. It’s too crowded, the equipment keeps breaking and it’s a mess. Here’s the list of problems.

2. The gym doesn’t even have basic hygiene facilities such as a sanitizer, paper towels and toilet paper.

3. It’s extremely crowded. For the amount of space the gym has, there’s way too many people. So you’ll spend atleast 30 minutes extra waiting for equipment.

4. The gym has a general trainer fit for nothing. They stand around and talk but don’t find people who need help. If you don’t have a trainer or a partner, or a friend, then you are stranded when you need a spot.

5. When you join the gym, they don’t conduct a fitness analysis, they don’t introduce anything. My sister joined as a new member and none of this was done for her. Infact she was spoken rudely to.

6. They machines keep breaking down - which is still fine. But they have a maintenance day every month where nothing gets fixed. The dumbbells are extremely dirty, the machines give you contact dermatitis. It’s disgustingly dirty.

Pros:

1. The gym has a good crowd.

2. They have good marketing skills, they are marketing themselves as an elite gym.

3. The gym looks good in pictures.

I have been working out for the last 10 years and I have been a member of one gym for 6 years out of those 10 years. This is my first bad experience in a gym.

I’ve been training Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu  with Coach Mark for a while now, and honestly, the difference I feel is huge. My stamina has improved a lot, I move better, my strength and cardio are way better, and I understand techniques much more clearly now.

What I appreciate most is how practical his teaching is. Coach doesn’t just show moves  he makes sure you actually understand why they work and how to apply them properly. You can tell he’s a black belt with real experience, but he teaches in a very grounded and easy to understand way.

Every session pushes me physically, but it also clears my mind. I leave training feeling more confident, sharper, and better overall.

reviews.author: Lankesh lanka
reviews.text:
I've been a member of this MMA gym for the past two years, and it has become a huge part of my life. From the moment I started, I felt like part of a community. While I enjoy all the classes, I have developed a true passion for BJJ. Coach Mark is an incredible instructor—his attention to detail, clear communication, and positive attitude make every class a great learning experience. The gym's environment is both challenging and supportive, pushing me to be better while always feeling safe and encouraged. If you're serious about training, this is the place to be.
Highly recommend to the people who wants to transform the body and mind.

reviews.author: Pradyumna
reviews.text:
OctaFit has been an incredible place to train. The Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu program not only made me fitter and stronger but also sharpened my focus and discipline. The positive energy here is something special—it really motivates you to push yourself. Training under Coach Mark has been the highlight; his guidance gave me the confidence to learn, grow, and even compete, which was an amazing experience.

What makes OctaFit stand out is the community feeling—you’re surrounded by people who support and inspire you every day. I truly love it here and I’m going to miss everyone. Though I’m relocating, I’ll definitely come back to train whenever I’m around. For anyone serious about fitness or martial arts, this is without doubt the best place to train.

reviews.author: GC Gaurav
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at OctaFit Gym in JP Nagar for a while now, and honestly, I love it. The vibe here is awesome — everyone’s friendly, and you feel comfortable even if you’re just starting out.
Coach Mark is amazing — he really helps you progress at your own pace, whether you’re into Boxing, MMA, Jiu Jitsu, seeking weight loss, or building strength and stamina.
The programs are beginner-friendly and easy to follow, but if you stay consistent, you’ll keep climbing from beginner to intermediate to advanced levels. The 6-month and yearly memberships are great value for money and perfect for long-term fitness goals.
It’s one of the best and most affordable gyms in JP Nagar — real results, great people, and an amazing coach! 💪🔥

reviews.text:
I joined this gym last week (Friday), and honestly, it’s been a really great experience so far✨.

🏋️‍♀️. The gym is well-equipped with modern and high-tech machines. One thing I really liked is their body analysis machine—it gives detailed info about weight, hydration, protein levels, and more, which really helps if you're trying to gain or lose weight properly.

☺️. The staff is very helpful. The front desk explained everything clearly—from payments to how the gym works and what to expect. The trainers are also great—there are multiple trainers available, and they actively help everyone during workouts.

⭐️. Special mention to trainer Rahul—he’s an amazing coach. He’s fun, motivating, understanding, and makes workouts enjoyable. If you’re joining, I’d definitely recommend choosing him as your trainer.

💪. They even provide 2 free sessions with a trainer, which is super useful for beginners. Based on your goal (weight gain/loss), they create a personalized workout plan and even give a food chart. 💰. For the price it’s honestly worth it considering all the facilities they provide.

🥰. Overall, the gym has a very positive vibe, is high-tech, and a great place to start or continue your fitness journey.

reviews.author: Yashashwini R
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Gold’s Gym for the past two months, and it has been an incredibly positive experience - especially as someone who walked in as a complete beginner. Starting at a gym can feel intimidating, but the environment here is welcoming and motivating, which made it much easier to stay consistent.

A big part of this experience has been my trainer, Sachin. From day one, he has been extremely supportive, patient, and attentive. Since I had no prior gym experience, he takes the time to explain every exercise properly, focusing on correct form and building confidence step by step. What I really appreciate is how he keeps the sessions engaging and enjoyable, so working out never feels like a chore. He is also very flexible and thoughtful when it comes to nutrition guidance. Instead of giving a rigid plan, he helps tailor meal suggestions that fit into my routine and preferences, which makes it much easier to follow consistently. He regularly checks in on progress and ensures that the program evolves as I improve.

After just two months, I feel stronger, more energetic, and much more comfortable in the gym. I’m really happy with the progress I’ve made so far, and a lot of credit goes to Sachin for making the journey so encouraging and structured.

If you’re looking to start your fitness journey, I would definitely recommend Gold’s Gym — and especially Sachin as your trainer.

The equipment quality is good, and the gym is well-maintained. One thing I really appreciate is the cleanliness they have staff who regularly clean the machines after use, which makes the environment much more hygienic and comfortable.

The trainers here are excellent. I’ve been training with Suraj, who is a general trainer, and he has been guiding me since day one. The gym has a good number of trainers, including both general and personal trainers. Those who opt for personal training get dedicated attention, while general trainers are still available to support others, so overall guidance is always accessible.

Another plus point is the space it’s large enough that the gym never really feels overcrowded. The overall vibe is also great and keeps you motivated to stay consistent.

Overall, I’m very satisfied with my experience and would definitely recommend this gym to anyone looking for a good place to work out with proper guidance.

reviews.author: Amrita Raj
reviews.text:
I joined Liftr around 2 months ago when I learned about their 6week transformation program. I wasnt able to lose even a single kilo before but ended up losing 4 kilos and 6 inches during this program. So joining this gym has been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my fitness journey in 2026!

As a beginner, my major concern was if I’d be able to do all the exercises properly without injuring myself but to my surprise the coaches here pay close attention to your forms and posture during every exercise, and even give you alternative options in case of issues such as back pain, knee pain, etc to avoid any further pain or injuries (You wont get this in a normal gym unless you are going for a PT). Also, I really appreciate that they don’t just focus on workouts but also guide you with proper nutrition, diet planning, and overall lifestyle improvements to help you achieve your goals. They regularly track progress, monitor performance, and make sure you stay consistent and motivated.

Also, the coaches here are extremely supportive and knowledgeable. And even though all of them have helped me in some way or the other, I owe a big part of my progress to Megha, who was my primary coach during the program and helped me stay consistent with my diet and workouts and Afthab for making sure my workout forms looked less like random movements and more like actual exercises since day 1. 🤪

Overall, the environment is positive, motivating, and welcoming for both beginners and experienced fitness enthusiasts. So, I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a gym with professional coaching and genuine guidance! :)

reviews.author: Ankit Jethi
reviews.text:
I completed the 6-week program at Liftr and had a very positive experience. The coaching and accountability were excellent — my coach checked in daily on meals, gave clear feedback, and kept me consistent throughout. The workout sessions were well structured, effective, and helped me feel noticeably stronger.

Pricing and additional batch timings could be improved, but overall it’s a solid program with real support and results. I’d definitely recommend Liftr to anyone looking for guided training and accountability.

reviews.author: Pratik Parag
reviews.text:
I recently completed the 6-week transformation program at Liftr Gym, and the results have been truly impressive—I lost 5 kgs in just 6 weeks!

What sets Liftr apart is their well-structured approach. The training program was thoughtfully designed, progressive, and tailored to my fitness level, ensuring I stayed challenged without feeling overwhelmed. Alongside the workouts, the diet plan was practical and easy to follow, which made a huge difference in achieving consistent results.

A special highlight was the continuous 1-on-1 coaching. My coach closely monitored my progress, provided regular feedback, and kept me motivated throughout the journey. This level of personal attention really helped me stay accountable and push beyond my limits.

Overall, it’s a highly professional and result-oriented program. I would definitely recommend Liftr Gym to anyone looking for a structured transformation with real, measurable outcomes.

reviews.text:
Honestly, starting training with coach@Harshat Ram  has been one of the best things I’ve done for myself. He’s consistent, pays close attention to form, and actually makes sure I’m doing things the right way—not just rushing through workouts.
What I really like is that he knows when to push me and when to ease off. Some days I don’t feel like showing up, but I still end up having a solid session because of his energy and guidance. I can see and feel the difference in my strength and overall confidence.
Really grateful to have a trainer who genuinely cares about progress and well-being. Makes the whole process feel a lot more real and sustainable.

Healthy hustle fitness hub ,the vibe of the space also makes a big difference. The people are friendly and focused, which keeps me motivated, and the gym itself is well-maintained with all the right equipment and amenities. It feels comfortable and easy to show up, even on low-energy days.

reviews.author: Yogeshwaran Ramakrishnan
reviews.text:
I’ve been training with Harshat for three years now, and the progress I’ve seen has been truly meaningful. I’ve seen clear improvements in strength, power, and muscle mass—something that naturally becomes harder after 40. What’s reassuring is that my muscle mass has actually been on an upward trend over these three years.

A bit of context: back in 2018, I developed Acromioclavicular (AC) joint inflammation from doing a lot of CrossFit, triggered by an intense pull-up challenge. For nearly five years after that, I stayed away from strength training and focused mostly on mobility and running. While mobility is important, I eventually realised that mobility without strength has its limits. I started training with Harshat in January 2023, and it’s been a game-changer.

Harshat is extremely well-versed, constantly learning, and stays up to date with the latest thinking in sports science and sports medicine. There’s no one-size-fits-all approach—every session is customised. He’s very attentive to form, movement, and also body language and mental cues. On days when work stress is high or sleep has been poor, he instinctively scales things back, which is invaluable if you have a demanding job.

His training style builds a hybrid athlete—CrossFit-like elements without the recklessness or injury risk. The environment is calm, motivating, and focused on long-term sustainability. I train 3–4 days a week with him and do cardio on the remaining days. He also leads by example, training for and competing in events like "Yoddha race" and HYROX, and often joins clients for runs or treks around Bangalore. If you live around Coffee Board Layout, Kempapura, or Prestige Misty Waters, I’d strongly recommend checking out Harshat’s gym. He might just be the trainer and training partner you have been looking for.

reviews.author: Mayuri Bhattacharya
reviews.text:
I restarted my fitness journey after a long break due to a chronic illness, which had led to muscle loss and weight gain. Harshat (trainer) made the process so much easier by first conducting a detailed fitness assessment and then tailoring the workouts to my specific needs and limitations. The sessions are thoughtfully structured, with a great balance of hypertrophy and athletic exercises, and no two workouts ever feel the same.

The best part is the gradual but steady progress—I’ve seen clear improvements in my body composition, strength, and even my medical test results, which my doctor is very pleased with. Beyond the physical changes, I’ve noticed a big boost in my mental health and overall confidence.

The trainer is extremely knowledgeable, professional, and approachable, always taking the time to explain and guide. The gym environment is also ideal, especially for beginners to intermediate fitness enthusiasts.

I’m genuinely grateful for the support and guidance—it has been a game-changer for my health and lifestyle.

reviews.author: Iman Syed
reviews.text:
Weird, fishy experience where they wouldn't even talk to me.

I messaged them to inquire about the membership fees, they told me to meet in person. Annoying, since I'd be wasting my time going there if the fee wasn't in my budget.

Anyway, I went to inquire about the fees in person, and they wanted my name and contact details before answering. No explanation as to why. If there was a security concern or they wanted to make sure someone wasn't abusing a trial session, I would've understood. Instead, they just didn't want to talk to me at all without taking down my details first.

I can't even give a proper rating of the gym because they don't want people to come here it seems. I wouldn't have given this rating if they had informed me that they wanted my details when they messaged me. I would have just ignored and forgotten about the gym. But intentionally wasting my time like this and refusing to acknowledge the most basic question about ANY service is really disrespectful and bizarre.

I have never had such an experience anywhere else, across any industry. They made it very clear that communication and transparency is something they don't care about at all.

reviews.author: Anandhu Ajith
reviews.text:
The lady at the front desk is extremely rude and unprofessional. She keeps changing her statements and does not know how to communicate respectfully with paying members. What is promised at the time of joining is conveniently denied later.

I joined because of their attractive offer, but once the payment was made, the attitude completely changed.

They deducted one full month from my membership for an unclear and unreasonable reason, and then asked me to pay again to continue. There was no proper transparency or prior communication about this. It feels misleading and unfair.

The trainers are good, but the management and front desk handling are highly disappointing.

This kind of behavior seriously damages trust in the gym.

Reply:

Thank you for your response.

First, I did not “keep changing plans.” I only expected the membership terms that were clearly communicated to me at the time of joining. When those terms were later denied or modified, I naturally asked for clarification.

Regarding respect — respect is mutual. I have always communicated firmly but within my rights as a paying customer. Expecting clarity and accountability is not disrespect. However, being spoken to dismissively and having statements changed repeatedly is not professional customer service.

You mentioned the “free gift” has zero value. That statement itself raises concerns. If it truly has zero value, then why promote it as part of the membership offer? Customers join based on what is communicated to them. Calling it “zero value” later only strengthens the impression that it was used as a marketing tactic.

reviews.author: Babita Upadhyay
reviews.text:
I am usually not someone who writes harsh reviews, but this experience has been extremely disappointing.
It has been over three months since I lost my earbuds case at Cult Neo, Electronic City. I immediately raised a complaint and requested access to the CCTV footage for that day. However, despite repeated follow-ups, I have neither received any recordings nor seen any meaningful action taken on the matter.
What made the situation even more frustrating was the lack of support from the staff. On the day of the incident, the admin was unavailable. In my experience, this particular admin is often found sleeping inside the trainer's room during working hours. When I returned later that evening to seek assistance, his response was simply that I should take better care of my personal belongings. While I completely understand that members are responsible for safeguarding their own items, a little empathy and professionalism would have been appreciated. He even refused to register a complaint.
Fortunately, the next day, another admin was much more helpful and assisted me in formally lodging the complaint. However, despite the complaint being registered, I have not seen any progress, updates, or effort to investigate the matter.
The most disappointing part is not the loss itself, but the apparent lack of accountability and customer support. After three months, I still have no resolution, no CCTV footage, and no clear communication regarding the status of my complaint.

reviews.author: sudha a
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Apple Fitness.The biggest concern is the complete lack of professionalism in how customer feedback and complaints are handled.
Whenever members raise genuine concerns instead of addressing them constructively, the staff tend to become defensive and confrontational. On multiple occasions, several staff members would collectively gang up on a member rather than listen, understand the problem, and work towards a resolution. This creates an uncomfortable environment for anyone trying to voice legitimate concerns.

A gym should be a place where members feel respected, valued, and heard. Unfortunately, the management culture here appears to discourage feedback and accountability. Customer service is extremely poor, and there seems to be little effort to handle complaints professionally. Respectful communication and conflict resolution are basic expectations in any service industry, but those standards are noticeably lacking here.
The management, Instead of focusing on member satisfaction, there is a tendency to dismiss concerns and create unnecessary confrontations. I would strongly advise potential members to carefully consider these factors before joining.

There are many gyms in the area that offer better facilities, more professional staff, and a much healthier environment. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this gym.

reviews.author: Tejas Yadav
reviews.text:
Disappointing Experience – Needs Serious Improvement

There’s hardly any space to work out here. The equipment is packed way too close together, and to make things worse, the gym is overcrowded. It’s frustrating and unsafe, especially when you’re trying to navigate around people and equipment.

On top of that, a lot of members don’t even bother to re-rack their weights. Dumbbells are often left lying all over the floor, creating a cluttered and hazardous environment.

The cleaner uncle, in particular, was extremely unprofessional. When I politely asked him to clean the chest bench, he  made a face and mumbled something like he was being forced to do it. Later, when I asked where the drinking water was, he didn’t even speak, just rolled his eyes and gestured in a vague direction. That kind of attitude is unacceptable, especially in a customer facing role.

This gym really needs better crowd management, clearer rules on equipment use, and more respectful, helpful staff. Right now, it’s far from a place you'd want to keep coming back to.

reviews.author: Anitha Guru
reviews.text: I took the personal training for 36 sessions with Abhishek S as my trainer. My goal was building strength post injury. Abhishek made sure that there was a clarity right from day one on how the sessions will pan out. He took into account the smallest of details while charting out the workout plan. Even during the workouts, he set a realistic pace for each week recognising how much I can/cannot push. There would always be discussions on how a particular workout works and benefits me. I was able to better understand and remember the workout and avoid injuries. He would patiently answer every single question (I asked a lot of questions!) With every passing week I was able to see a gradual increase in my strength and gain better posture. Having completed the sessions with visible changes, I am motivated to keep this routine going. 5 stars for personal training and my trainer Abhishek S. The design of the app is impressive. It is user friendly and really good. I get to easily go back and forth to monitor what I have been doing. The only downside of the app is that all the workouts info in the app disappears once the sessions are up. I hope they can be made available at least for the 3 month subscription period and not just till the last session.

reviews.author: Mithun
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the conditions at the Cult DF dance class. The indoor temperature during the session was maintained at 18°C, while the outside temperature was already 16°C. In such cold conditions, the body does not warm up properly, which completely defeats the purpose of attending a high-energy dance or fitness class. Instead of preventing injuries, this environment actually increases the risk of muscle strain and discomfort.

A dance workout is meant to elevate body temperature, improve mobility, and energize participants. When the room temperature is almost the same as the outside weather, it makes the entire session ineffective and unpleasant. This shows a clear lack of understanding of basic fitness and safety requirements.

Additionally, I have been raising concerns for many days about the excessively loud speaker noise during classes. The volume is uncomfortable and can potentially cause long-term hearing issues. Despite repeatedly bringing this to the attention of the centre staff and Cult, no action has been taken so far. This reflects poorly on both the centre management and Cult’s commitment to member well-being.

As a paying member, I expect a safe, comfortable, and professionally managed workout environment. Ignoring basic temperature control and noise safety standards is unacceptable. I sincerely hope the centre manager and Cult team take this feedback seriously and implement immediate corrective actions, or members will be forced to reconsider continuing their membership.
